gloss: to improve; to make better; to reform

definitions.gloss: to improve; to make better; to reform
definitions.explanation: To change something for the better, addressing problems or deficiencies. Used for both tangible things (processes, conditions) and abstract things (relationships, situations). Central to Japanese business philosophy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}→生活習慣：19568_seikatsushuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}する。
⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We held a meeting to improve the working environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{改善|かいぜん}した。
examples.english: My physical condition improved greatly through diet and exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改善|かいぜん}しなければ、⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上|あ}がらない→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: If we don't improve this problem, customer satisfaction won't increase.

notes:
One of the most well-known Japanese business concepts internationally. The noun ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧ (kaizen) refers to continuous, incremental improvement and is widely used as a loanword in English business contexts, particularly in manufacturing and lean management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: operational improvement
- ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: constitutional improvement
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: environmental improvement
- ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: improvement measure
- ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: point of improvement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {直|なお}す: to fix — corrects something broken rather than making something better
- ⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧: to improve — emphasizes raising quality or level upward
- ⟦{是正|ぜせい}→是正：05631_zesei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to correct — fixing something wrong or unjust, more formal
